systems.system: Integrated electronic system for tracking the movement of medicines
systems.country_label: منظومة إلكترونية متكاملة لتتبع حركة الأدوية
systems.tiers: links the Ministry's pharmacy department, the Medical Supply Organisation and hospital pharmacy departments; tracks medicines from arrival to dispensing to hospitals and health facilities

note: Activation announced 2025-10-06 of a medicines stock-tracking system; stock only, so single-function and no HMIS or EMR fact.
